title: The Empty Autopsy
author: Silas Brightwater
blurb: Bram Vane, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
